title: Analista de Dados Pleno
description:
Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de SPM, para trabalhar de forma híbrida sendo os dias presenciais no Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo.

Ao assumir o cargo de Analista de Dados Pleno na Afya , seu objetivo principal será identificar e analisar as principais dores de negócios, aplicando técnicas e conceitos adequados. Ele deve integrar-se ao cotidiano da área de negócios, promovendo a autonomia no uso de dados. Além disso, é importante incentivar o uso de uma fonte única de verdade, evitando shadow IT. O profissional também deve realizar análises combinadas de dados internos e externos, criando painéis estratégicos. É essencial disponibilizar dados de forma simples e estruturada para apoiar decisões. Por fim, deve interagir autonomamente com as áreas de negócios para aprender sobre os diversos produtos e serviços da empresa.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Main responsibilities

  • Transformar perguntas de negócio em análises estratégicas , combinando SQL, planilhas e outras fontes, para orientar decisões críticas de produto, serviço e crescimento.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros e o time de dados na criação de pipelines, scripts e processos que garantam qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Aplicar métodos estatísticos e experimentais (A/B tests, análises causais, hipóteses) para avaliar impacto de mudanças em produto e identificar oportunidades de otimização.
  • Construir e evoluir dashboards estratégicos em Power BI , priorizando clareza e impacto, e guiando discussões sobre tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Traduzir insights em storytelling executivo , conectando dados a narrativas claras e recomendações práticas para negócio e produto.
  • Entender profundamente o comportamento dos usuários , analisando engajamento, retenção e jornadas para antecipar melhorias de produto e apoiar decisões sobre novas features.
  • Analisar benchmarks e tendências de mercado , trazendo perspectivas externas que complementem os dados internos e apontem direções para inovação e competitividade.
  • Ser o ponto de contato confiável para áreas de negócio , disseminando conhecimento sobre métricas, catálogo de dados e boas práticas de governança.
  • Documentar e manter metadados, métricas e relatórios , garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade das informações usadas em decisões estratégicas.
  • Conduzir estudos analíticos ponta a ponta , do levantamento da necessidade até a comunicação de conclusões, influenciando priorização de roadmap e decisões de produto.
  • Zelar pela qualidade e integridade dos dados , propondo e implementando processos de monitoramento, validação e melhoria contínua.
  • Definir e refinar indicadores-chave de negócio , ajudando a empresa a medir o que realmente importa para crescimento sustentável.

Requirements and skills

  • SQL avançado (queries complexas, CTEs, funções janela).
  • Python para análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado.
  • Power BI (modelagem, DAX, dashboards).
  • Métodos estatísticos aplicados: amostragem, testes, intervalos de confiança, experimentos/A/B.
  • Noções de tracking de produto (Segment, GA4, Snowplow) e taxonomia de eventos.
  • Cloud Data Warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery ou Snowflake).

Diferenciais

  • dbt (modelagem modular, testes).
  • Airflow ou outra ferramenta de orquestração.
  • Databricks.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de produto (retenção, engajamento, funil, cohort).

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Company Overview


If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!


Role Summary


The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. The FST offers real‑time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites, providing world‑class service and creating lasting competitive advantage.


Responsibilities



  • Perform direct, in‑person service calls in response to customer requests.

  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly.

  • Work side‑by‑side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required.

  • Supervise the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly.

  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule.

  • Check equipment before commissioning and start‑up and evaluate performance during and after start‑up.

  • Monitor the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment.

  • Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products.

  • Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering.

  • Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged.

  • Other duties as assigned.


Requirements



  • Mechanical Technician with active CFT.

  • Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry.

  • Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in installing mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc.

  • Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference.

  • Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges.

  • Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.

  • Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills.

  • Intermediate English.

  • An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job.

  • Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods.

  • Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers.

  • Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.


Desirable Skills



  • Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable.

  • Professional certifications in this area.


About Flowserve


Flowserve is a world‑leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000+ employees in 50+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges itself to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.


Equal Employment Opportunity


EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co‑workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access flowserv.careers.com as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an email to In order to quickly respond to your request, please use the words "Accommodation Request" as your subject line of your email. For more information, read the Accessibility Process.

title: Luxury Account Manager - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Sobre nós

Com mais de 200 marcas vendidas em quase 180 países, somos a empresa líder mundial em bebidas premium. Traga sua paixão e use sua curiosidade enquanto explora, colabora e inova para construir marcas que os consumidores adoram. Juntamente com pessoas apaixonadas de todo o mundo, você testará novas ideias, aprenderá e crescerá e desbloqueará um futuro mais brilhante e emocionante.

Junte-se a nós para criar uma carreira que vale a pena comemorar.

Sobre a oportunidade

No ecossistema de crescimento da Diageo, a área Comercial de Luxo desempenha um papel essencial na construção de valor de marca, fidelização de clientes e geração de receita incremental. Nesse cenário, o(a) Luxury Account Manager se torna uma figura estratégica, atuando como ponte entre a excelência operacional e a experiência premium que os consumidores esperam das marcas do portfólio de luxo da Diageo.

1. Fortalecimento da Presença de Marca

O(a) Luxury Account Manager é responsável por garantir que as marcas de alto padrão da Diageo estejam posicionadas de forma consistente e aspiracional nos pontos de venda e canais estratégicos. Isso inclui negociações com parceiros premium, ativações exclusivas e curadoria de experiências que reforcem o storytelling das marcas.

2. Relacionamento com Clientes de Alto Valor

Esse(a) profissional atua diretamente com contas-chave e clientes de alto poder aquisitivo, desenvolvendo relacionamentos de longo prazo que vão além da transação comercial. A personalização do atendimento e a compreensão aprofundada do comportamento do consumidor de luxo são diferenciais que impactam diretamente na retenção e expansão de contas.

3. Alavancagem de Crescimento Sustentável

Integrado à Diretoria de Growth, o(a) Luxury Account Manager contribui com insights de mercado, tendências de consumo e oportunidades de inovação que alimentam estratégias de crescimento. Sua atuação ajuda a identificar nichos e canais emergentes, além de garantir que as metas comerciais estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de expansão da companhia.

4. Integração com Times Globais e Regionais

Por operar em um segmento altamente conectado com padrões internacionais, esse(a) Luxury Account Manager também facilita a integração entre as diretrizes globais da Diageo e as particularidades do mercado local, assegurando consistência na execução e adaptabilidade nas estratégias.

Seus principais desafios serão:

  • Ser o(a) arquiteto(a) do luxo no coração do Rio , desenvolvendo o negócio de marcas premium em contas on-trade e parcerias estratégicas na cidade mais icônica do Brasil.
  • Criar experiências de marca inesquecíveis , conectando todos os pontos da jornada omnichannel do consumidor - dos bares mais exclusivos aos eventos mais influentes.
  • Gerir contas de alto prestígio , como bares sofisticados e restaurantes emblemáticos, além de identificar novas oportunidades que elevem o portfólio de luxo da Diageo.
  • Mais do que vender, você vai encantar : seu objetivo será aumentar o reconhecimento, a experimentação e a afinidade com as marcas, promovendo experiências de consumo de altíssima qualidade.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com os times de Cultura, Advocacy, Digital e Mídia , cocriando planos de execução de marca que traduzam o luxo sob a ótica do consumidor moderno.
  • Ser o(a) guardiã(o) da excelência na execução , garantindo que cada ponto de contato com o shopper reflita a sofisticação e o posicionamento das marcas de luxo.
  • Atuar em parceria com o Trade Marketing , você desenvolverá materiais e ativações sob medida para cada conta, incluindo treinamentos de equipe, gestão de back bar, impressão de menus e merchandising de alto padrão.
  • Colaborar com o time Comercial para definir prioridades, listas de contas e ações que impulsionem a performance das marcas prioritárias no on-trade.
  • Desenvolver planos de ativação com foco em advocacy , em parceria com os times de Marketing e Cultura, fortalecendo o vínculo emocional entre marca e consumidor.
  • Estabelecer e manterá os padrões de ativação de luxo , garantindo consistência, inovação e excelência em cada execução.

O que esperamos?

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de contas de luxo , com habilidade para desenvolver parcerias estratégicas em ambientes sofisticados e altamente influentes.
  • Conhecimento dos lugares certos e das pessoas certas , com habilidade para construir relações sólidas com influenciadores-chave da indústria, conectando marcas de luxo aos ambientes onde elas realmente fazem a diferença.
  • Entendimento do consumidor de luxo , reconhecendo perfis, atitudes e tendências, e habilidade para traduzir esses insights em ações que geram conexão emocional e fidelidade.
  • Domínio da jornada omnichannel do consumidor , com capacidade de criar experiências integradas e memoráveis em múltiplos pontos de contato - do bar ao digital.
  • Perfil comercial com olhar curador , capaz de identificar oportunidades de negócio em contas icônicas e elevar o portfólio de luxo com propostas de valor diferenciadas.
  • Mentalidade voltada à experiência , com foco em aumentar reconhecimento, experimentação e afinidade com as marcas por meio de ativações de alto padrão.
  • Habilidade de colaboração multidisciplinar , trabalhando de forma integrada com os times de Cultura, Advocacy, Digital, Mídia e Marketing para cocriar planos de execução que traduzam o luxo sob a ótica do consumidor moderno.
  • Excelência operacional , com atenção aos detalhes e comprometimento com a qualidade em cada execução - seja em treinamentos, materiais de merchandising ou gestão de back bar.
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em performance , colaborando com o time Comercial para definir prioridades, contas estratégicas e ações que impulsionem resultados no on-trade.
  • Conhecimento em ativação de marca e advocacy , com habilidade para fortalecer o vínculo emocional entre consumidor e marca por meio de experiências autênticas e relevantes.
  • Compromisso com a consistência e inovação , mantendo os padrões de ativação de luxo sempre atualizados e alinhados às melhores práticas globais.
  • Comunicação com impacto , demonstrando habilidades de comunicação refinadas, capazes de influenciar, inspirar e engajar parceiros estratégicos e equipes internas.
  • Sede de fazer acontecer , com motivação por resultados e com energia para criar experiências memoráveis nos principais eventos e contas Top Luxury Accounts (TLA) da cidade.
  • CNH B em dia.

Declaração de Trabalho Flexível:

A flexibilidade é a chave para o nosso sucesso. De meio período e horas compactadas a diferentes locais, nosso pessoal trabalha de forma flexível de maneiras adequadas a eles. Fale conosco sobre o que a flexibilidade significa para você, para que você seja apoiado desde o primeiro dia.

Declaração de diversidade:

Nosso propósito é celebrar a vida, todos os dias, em todos os lugares. E criar uma cultura inclusiva, onde todos se sintam valorizados e que possam pertencer, é uma parte crucial disso.

Abraçamos a diversidade no sentido mais amplo possível. Isso significa que você será bem-vindo e celebrado por quem você é apenas por ser você. Você fará parte e ajudará a construir e defender uma cultura inclusiva que celebra pessoas de diferentes gêneros, etnias, habilidades, idades, orientação sexual, classe social, formações educacionais, experiências, mentalidades e muito mais.

Nossa ambição é criar as empresas de produtos de consumo com melhor desempenho, mais confiáveis e respeitadas do mundo. Junte-se a nós e ajude a transformar nossos negócios à medida que levamos nossas marcas para o próximo nível e construímos novas como parte da formação da próxima geração de celebrações para consumidores em todo o mundo.

Sente-se inspirado? Então esta pode ser a oportunidade para você.

Se você precisar de um ajuste razoável, certifique-se de capturar essas informações ao enviar sua inscrição.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data‑driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Dentro da diretoria de Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura, a Fábrica de Cenários é a área responsável pela construção e entrega dos cenários que dão vida às produções de entretenimento, dramaturgia e eventos do Grupo Globo.

Reúne profissionais das mais diversas disciplinas — carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamentos e gestão técnica — que transformam projetos criativos em estruturas físicas com excelência técnica e artística.

Nosso desafio é equilibrar inovação, qualidade e velocidade de produção, em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante evolução, que integra arte, engenharia e tecnologia.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente a execução de obras e montagens cenográficas, garantindo o cumprimento dos projetos, cronogramas e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Realizar medições, levantamentos e controle de execução das etapas construtivas (carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamento, elétrica, etc.);
  • Realizar leitura de projetos, cortes e detalhamentos técnicos em projetos, assegurando a compatibilização entre os projetos de arquitetura, cenografia e infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar o time de orçamentos e suprimentos com informações técnicas e quantitativos de materiais;
  • Acompanhar fornecedores e prestadores de serviços durante as etapas de produção e montagem, garantindo conformidade técnica e segurança;
  • Contribuir para o controle de qualidade e atualização de padrões técnicos e construtivos da Fábrica;
  • Apoiar a implementação de boas práticas de Lean Construction e melhoria contínua nos processos produtivos.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação técnica completa em Edificações;
  • Experiência prévia em obras civis, cenográficas ou de estruturas temporárias;
  • Domínio com Projetos (leitura, interpretação e elaboração de plantas);
  • Conhecimento básico em medições, orçamentos e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Fábrica de Cenários e eventuais deslocamentos para estúdios e locações externas.
  • Conhecimento em Revit, SketchUp ou softwares 3D voltados à construção e cenografia;
  • Experiência em projetos de televisão, eventos, espetáculos ou produção de cenários;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Construction e metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de equipes multidisciplinares e integração de disciplinas;
  • Curso complementa­rio em Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão de Projetos.

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link:

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. BASE SALARY

$1,500 - $2,500 (USD) per month.

YOUR ROLE

You are a detail-oriented, results-driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches which connect millions of consumers to our clients monthly! You will also oversee and optimize our operations to ensure they meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. Additionally, you have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry-specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally will enable you to implement effective solutions, making a significant impact on our company's operational excellence.

  • Quickly becoming a subject matter expert for all QA related processes.

WHAT YOU NEED TO Succeed

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm

  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.

  • Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.
  • Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.
  • Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.
  • Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Instructional Design: Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Instructional Design: Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Instructional Design: Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Team Leadership: Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Team Leadership: Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Project Management: Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Project Management: Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Project Management: Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Project Management: Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Project Management: Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • Project Management: The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences.

Join to apply for the Billing Analyst I role at Airswift .

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years, Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un‑invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non‑funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.

description:
Join to apply for the Paid Media Specialist role at Bluelight .

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high‑quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Here’s What You’ll Get To Work On

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed‑won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full‑Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Here’s the experience we’re looking for

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands‑on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full‑Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top‑of‑funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Here’s what we’re looking for this role to achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead‑to‑deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full‑funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Bluelight by 2x.

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

- Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

- Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

- Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

title: Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain
description:
Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain

Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 5 ou équivalent

Fonction : Ingénieur scientifique contractuel

Contexte et atouts du poste

Cadre scientifique: ANR MEGA

Les glissements sous-marins géants km3) sont présents dans les séries sédimentaires Quaternaire des marges continentales passives. Si leurs âges coïncident avec des fluctuations eustatiques, il est encore difficile d’expliquer comment d’aussi grandes ruptures sont générées sur de faibles pentes (<2˚) en l'absence d'un facteur déclenchant tel qu’un séisme. Des hypothèses proposent le rôle de la dissociation des hydrates de gaz et de l’augmentation des pressions interstitielles. Le projet MEGA explorera ces hypothèses grâce aux premières modélisations reliant la stabilité des hydrates de gaz, les variations de pression/température sur le fond marin et la stabilité des pentes. Il s’appuyera sur une comparaison innovante des systèmes du Nil et de l'Amazone, leurs forçages climatiques différant au cours des cycles glaciaires-interglaciaires. En l’absence de cas historiques de méga glissements, MEGA propose de modéliser leurs conséquences en terme de tsunami sur les zones côtières.

L’ objectif est de modéliser et simuler numériquement des tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements sous-marins géants en s'appuyant sur le couplage de deux codes numériques existants: Shaltop pour le glissement de terrain, et Freshkiss3D pour la propagation du tsunami.

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des géologues de L'Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris (ISTeP ) et des mathématicien·nes de l'équipe projet ANGE inria Paris/LJLL.

Mission confiée

  • Étude de stratégies de couplage numérique entre Shaltop et Freshkiss3D.
  • Simulation de différents scénarios de glissements de terrain géants sur des zones géographiques précises.
  • Déterminer le rôle de la stratification en température de l'océan

La personne recrutée pourra s'appuyer sur l'approche numérique développée lors d'une précédente collaboration (ANR ALBAMAR) et sur les résultats déjà obtenus dans le cadre de ce projet.

Lieux de travail : ISTeP, Sorbonne Université, Paris. De courts séjours chez les partenaires du projet sont susceptibles d'avoir lieu (UMR Géoazur, UMR EPOC, Linnaeus University en Suède,Fluminense Federal University et Université d'état de Rio de Janeiro au Brésil).

Collaboration :
La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec Sara Lafuerza (ISTeP), Nina Aguillon (LJLL/ Inria Paris), Jacques Sainte-Marie (Inria Paris) et Bernard Di Martino (Université de Corse).

Responsabilités :
La personne recrutée a la charge de développer le couplage numérique et prendra des initiatives pour communiquer les résultats obtenus aux partenaires du projet.

Pilotage/Management :
La personne recrutée pourra être amener à former un/une étudiante en thèse à la simulation numérique.

Principales activités

Principales activés:

  • Implémenter des scénarios de réaction de l'océan à un glissement sous-marin géant
  • Déterminer les paramètres pertinents
  • Présenter l’avancée des travaux aux partenaires
  • Proposer des améliorations de stratégie numérique

Activités complémentaires :

  • Participer à l'écriture des rapports
  • Initier à l'utilisation du code les partenaires du projet
  • Restauration subventionnée
  • Transports publics remboursés partiellement
  • Congés: 7 semaines de congés annuels + 10 jours de RTT (base temps plein) + possibilité d'autorisations d'absence exceptionnelle (ex : enfants malades, déménagement)
  • Possibilité de télétravailet aménagement du temps de travail
  • Équipements professionnels à disposition (visioconférence, prêts de matériels informatiques, etc.)
  • Prestations sociales, culturelles et sportives (Association de gestion des œuvres sociales d'Inria)
  • Thème/Domaine : Sciences de la planète, de l'environnement et de l'énergie
    Calcul Scientifique(BAP E)
  • Date de prise de fonction souhaitée :
  • Durée de contrat : 11 mois
  • Date limite pour postuler :

Attention : Les candidatures doivent être déposées en ligne sur le site Inria. Le traitement des candidatures adressées par d'autres canaux n'est pas garanti.

Consignes pour postuler

Sécurité défense :
Ce poste est susceptible d’être affecté dans une zone à régime restrictif (ZRR), telle que définie dans le décret n° relatif à la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique de la nation (PPST). L’autorisation d’accès à une zone est délivrée par le chef d’établissement, après avis ministériel favorable, tel que défini dans l’arrêté du 03 juillet 2012, relatif à la PPST. Un avis ministériel défavorable pour un poste affecté dans une ZRR aurait pour conséquence l’annulation du recrutement.

Politique de recrutement :
Dans le cadre de sa politique diversité, tous les postes Inria sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap.

  • expérience en simulation numérique en mécanique des fluides
  • capacité à travailler en équipe

Inria est l’institut national de recherche dédié aux sciences et technologies du numérique. Il emploie 2600 personnes. Ses 215 équipes-projets agiles, en général communes avec des partenaires académiques, impliquent plus de 3900 scientifiques pour relever les défis du numérique, souvent à l’interface d’autres disciplines. L’institut fait appel à de nombreux talents dans plus d’une quarantaine de métiers différents. 900 personnels d’appui à la recherche et à l’innovation contribuent à faire émerger et grandir des projets scientifiques ou entrepreneuriaux qui impactent le monde. Inria travaille avec de nombreuses entreprises et a accompagné la création de plus de 200 start-up. L'institut s'eﬀorce ainsi de répondre aux enjeux de la transformation numérique de la science, de la société et de l'économie.

Overview

Recruitment Supervisor | Professional Psychologist | Talent Acquisition Specialist | Bilingual (EN/ES) | Full-Cycle Hiring Expert in the U.S.

Payroll Process Improvement Specialist (Remote)

Location: World wide (Remote - contractor)

Work schedule: Monday to Friday (8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. EST Time)

Salary: Up to $17.00/hr

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Payroll Process Improvement Specialist to lead the modernization and optimization of our payroll operations. This role will bridge technical expertise with operational payroll knowledge, working closely with our Finance team’s data analyst and payroll staff to streamline workflows, reduce reliance on SQL-based processes, and ensure scalability for future business needs. The ideal candidate will initially partner with our data analyst to implement recommendations from our recent payroll process review, then transition into a key member of the payroll team — with potential to grow into a leadership or management position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gain a deep understanding of current payroll operations, tools, and workflows.
  • Review and prioritize consultant recommendations for payroll process improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, eliminate redundancies, and improve process flexibility.
  • Partner with the Finance team’s data analyst to design and implement automation solutions and reporting enhancements.
  • Work with stakeholders to replace SQL-dependent steps with more user-friendly and maintainable solutions.
  • Document all process changes, configurations, and workflows for ongoing team use.
  • Implement process improvements that make payroll more dynamic and adaptable to changes in regulations, policies, and staffing.
  • Introduce monitoring tools, validation checks, and exception-handling processes to reduce errors.
  • Recommend and implement payroll technology enhancements, integrations, or system upgrades.

Transition to Operational Role

  • Take ownership of the updated payroll process once improvements are implemented.
  • Serve as a payroll subject matter expert within the organization.
  • Potentially lead the payroll function, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to team members.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience with US-based payroll processing, including multi-state payroll compliance and tax regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday payroll and/or OneSource Virtual (OSV) services.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas, and data analysis.
  • 3+ years of experience in payroll operations, payroll systems, or payroll process improvement.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll compliance, tax regulations, and reporting requirements.
  • Ability to translate technical/data concepts into business-friendly processes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose process inefficiencies.
  • Experience with automation tools, low-code/no-code platforms, or business intelligence/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx).
  • Understanding of SQL and ability to collaborate with technical/data teams.
  • Project management experience, especially in process improvement or systems implementation.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Payroll processing becomes faster, more accurate, and less reliant on the Data team.
  • The payroll process can easily adapt to organizational or regulatory changes.
  • Documentation and tools are in place for payroll staff to manage processes independently.
  • The individual is a trusted operational leader and payroll process expert.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Volunteer System Manager
description:
Volunteer System Manager

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Objetivo do Cargo

Ser o líder da área que transforma dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights , direcionando decisões estratégicas e táticas para crescimento da Diffucap. Atua como ponte entre inteligência de mercado, vendas e marketing, garantindo que os relatórios suportem o planejamento (incluindo LE trimestral), execução comercial e monitoramento de KPIs de produtividade, demanda e vendas.

Inteligência de Mercado & Prescrição

Desenvolver e manter modelos de mercado, prescrição (RX) e demanda para todas as classes terapêuticas da Diffucap.

Monitorar concorrentes, detectar tendências de mercado (entrada de genéricos, mudança de canais, novas tecnologias administrativas) e transformar em recomendações estratégicas. Exemplos: o desempenho de Deocil (via sublingual), diferenciação via canal digital, etc.

Fornecer relatórios executivos regulares para a liderança (VP Comercial, BD, Marketing) com visão de cenário, oportunidades de expansão e alertas de risco.

Colaborar com a área de Business Development para suportar análise de mercado, atratividade de classes, potencial de prescrição e competitividade.

Produtividade Comercial & Administração de Vendas

Criar e gerir o sistema de segmentação de médicos (quadrante A, B, C, D) baseado em critérios de potencial de prescrição, margem de contribuição e uso crônico — conforme a priorização definida pela liderança comercial.

Definir e monitorar KPIs de produtividade (visitas, repescagem, lançamento, share de voz, share de prescrição), implementando dashboards para vendas, marketing e treinamento.

Revisar e aprimorar os relatórios existentes (vendas e RX) para torná-los simples, intuitivos e com governança para diferentes perfis de usuário.

Garantir a governança dos 3 períodos de LE (Last Expectation) trimestrais: consolidar dados de vendas, despesas, forecast e alinhamento para reporte aos acionistas.

Suporte Estratégico & Processos

Oferecer à liderança, nas reuniões de planejamento anual (ex: plano 2026) e trimestral, o input analítico para tomada de decisão, sem necessariamente definir o “o que cada área deve fazer”, mas esclarecendo “o que o cenário exige”.

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Marketing, Marketing Digital, Treinamento, BD e Vendas para traduzir insights em ações — por exemplo, canais digitais complementares, influência, governança de influenciadores.

Estabelecer e manter processos de governança de dados, acesso, qualidade, periodicidade de reporte e visibilidade para todas as áreas relevantes.

Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Farmacêutica ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação ou MBA será diferencial.

Desejável experiência mínima de 5 anos em farmacêutica ou saúde, atuando em Inteligência de Mercado, Estratégia Comercial ou Analytics.

Habilidade analítica avançada: Excel, Power BI/Tableau, modelagem de cenários, previsão de mercado.

Forte comunicação e influência — capacidade de apresentar insights estratégicos para alta liderança e converter em planos de ação.

Care Natural Beauty | Grupo Granado abre as portas para você!

Um Gerente de Loja apaixonado por varejo, beleza limpa e experiência do cliente . Você será responsável por liderar a operação da loja, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, organizado e inspirador para os clientes e sua equipe. Seu papel é transformar cada visita à loja em uma jornada sensorial e emocional, promovendo um atendimento consultivo e autêntico.

  • Garantir a organização da loja, em geral.
  • Gerenciar com a equipe a reposição de produtos no salão de vendas;
  • Cuidar da decoração/disposição de produtos e realizar as trocas da vitrine;
  • Controlar e manter estoque: pedidos de produtos ao CD, conferência, estocagem de produtos, entrada de notas fiscais no sistema e emissão de notas fiscais referentes as saídas de produtos destinados (brindes, perdas, uso e consumo, testes, dentre outros);
  • Cumprir metas mensais de vendas com o objetivo de melhorar a produtividade, mantendo os índices de produtividade elevados;
  • Prestar atendimento na venda de kits para empresas/clientes e organização da entrega;
  • Manutenção geral da loja, incluindo solicitação de pintura, reparos, troca de lâmpadas, manutenção de ar condicionado, etc.;
  • Garantir a conciliação do caixa/movimento da loja por tipo de recebimento (cheques, dinheiro, cartão de crédito);
  • Realizar depósitos diários do caixa na conta da empresa;
  • Gerenciar o trabalho da equipe, garantindo cumprimento das obrigações trabalhistas;
  • Ministrar treinamentos teóricos e práticos;
  • Realizar processos de seleção de equipe, com apoio do RH.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Cosmetologia, Estética ou áreas afins;
  • Atuação como Gerente em redes varejistas;
  • Experiência anterior com cosméticos será considerada diferencial;
  • Ambiente integrado, alegre e positivo , onde a colaboração faz parte da rotina.
  • Vale-Refeição para curtir bons momentos e conversas descontraídas enquanto saboreia suas refeições.
  • Plano de saúde, odontológico e seguro de vida , porque cuidar de você e da sua família é prioridade. Afinal, mente sã em corpo são é o que importa!
  • Total Pass , para manter o corpo em movimento e a energia sempre lá em cima.
  • Descontos exclusivos nos produtos que você já ama: Granado, Phebo e Care Natural Beauty.
  • Ambiente que estimula a criatividade e o aprendizado contínuo , com apoio ao seu desenvolvimento por meio do nosso Programa de Educação Continuada — incluindo subsídios para cursos de aperfeiçoamento, graduação, pós-graduação e idiomas.
  • Parcerias com instituições de ensino e idiomas , como Estácio e Open English, para facilitar ainda mais sua jornada de desenvolvimento.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados , valorizando quem cresce e constrói junto com a gente.

É muita história para contar...

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
Senior Software Test Designer

At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high‑tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting‑edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real‑world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth.

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

Your responsibilities

  • Oversee the entire testing architecture/strategies, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing.
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and develop tools for qualification and integration.
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best results.
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment.
  • Review code and mentor junior engineers.
  • Share expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes.
  • Act as an advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspire others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Challenging and interesting projects in different domains.
  • Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues.
  • Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions.
  • Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy.
  • Tech events and knowledge sessions.

This will make you better:

  • Contract for an indefinite period of time.
  • An all‑in employee benefit package (€61,000 – €85,000 annually): inclusive of competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance.
  • Good secondary employment conditions: e.g., 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme, relocation budget.

This will keep you healthy:

  • A good work‑life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working.
  • An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym.
  • The home office support package will turn your 'home office' into an inspiring environment.
  • Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.

What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar.
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high‑tech domain.
  • Capability to define and oversee the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution.
  • Background in software development/automation and experience with object‑oriented programming and developing test frameworks for complex embedded systems.
  • Preferably experience with end‑to‑end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining the ROBOT test framework.
  • Proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher‑level testing (system integration, component testing), and familiarity with methods such as BDD, keyword‑driven testing, data‑driven testing, model‑based testing, and property‑based testing.
  • Team player, solution‑oriented, and proactive.
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills.
  • Good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high‑tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge‑to‑cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low‑level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System‑on‑Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.
